# Prompt2Post

> Prompt2Post (https://prompt2post.app) is an AI content studio for Instagram creators. You type one topic and it plans the slide structure, writes the copy, generates photoreal images, composites pixel-perfect text, and adds a caption and hashtags — producing a finished, on-brand Instagram carousel in minutes.

Key facts:
- Free plan: 3 posts per month, no credit card required. Pro from €9/month (100 posts), Creator €29/month (unlimited).
- Two-stage AI engine: develops a creative brief (tone, format, palette, slide count) before writing fact-rich copy per slide.
- Images are generated with FLUX; headlines are composited as vector typography, so text is always crisp.
- Brand Kit stores tone, colors, fonts, and language — every post is generated on-brand, one kit per client for agencies.
- Slide Studio: rewrite any slide with AI, edit copy by hand, or regenerate one image without extra credits.
- Idea Studio: describe a niche, get six ready-to-generate post ideas.
- Writes posts in 13 languages. Formats: square (1:1), portrait (4:5), story (9:16), wide (1.91:1), 1–10 slides.
- Repurpose: one click converts a carousel into an X post, LinkedIn post, Story hook, and a PDF for LinkedIn document posts.
- Export as ZIP or PDF with captions; shareable review links per post. Direct Instagram publishing and scheduling are coming soon.
